easy_fields.name: VQAonline
easy_fields.creator: Chongyan Chen, Mengchen Liu, Noel Codella, Yunsheng Li, Lu Yuan, Danna Gurari
easy_fields.description: VQAonline is the first Visual Question Answering (VQA) dataset where all content, including questions, images, context, and validated answers, originates from an authentic use case. Sourced from online question-answering community forums, it features significantly longer answers and diverse topics compared to existing VQA datasets.

G3_collection.reasoning: The paper dedicates a full section (3.1 Dataset Creation) and a supplementary section (I Dataset Collection) to detailing the data source (Stack Exchange), timeframe (Aug 2010 - Nov 2022), collection method (scraping), and filtering steps.

sections: I.2 User Intention Taxonomy and Definitions
G4_annotation.reasoning: The paper extensively discusses both implicit user-generated annotations (accepted answers, topics) and explicit crowdworker/expert annotations for user intent and model evaluation, including details on protocols, platforms (AMT), quality control, and annotator demographics. It also benchmarks various machine annotation tools (VLMs).

sections: I.4 Potential Benefits of User Intention in VQA
I.5 Potential Limitations and Societal Impact of VQAonline Dataset
G5_rai.reasoning: The paper explicitly addresses limitations of the dataset (representational bias, geographic imbalance), discusses potential biases in model training data, and outlines various intended use cases and societal benefits.

G6_processing.reasoning: The paper clearly describes preprocessing steps, including detailed filtering criteria and dataset splitting methodology, and mentions image format conversion. However, it does not detail a long-term maintenance or update plan for the dataset itself.
